epicgames_S36_FNCSMajor3_Final_EU.title: FNCS Major 3 Finals
epicgames_S36_FNCSMajor3_Final_EU.desc: This is a two-day event with 12 matches to crown the FNCS Major champions. The Major champions will not only claim their share of the prize pool — and their title as the best Fortnite players in the region — but will also wield the Blade of Champions for the following season, displaying their achievement for all to see!

epicgames_S36_SquidGroundVictoryDuosCup_.title: Squid Grounds Cash Cup
epicgames_S36_SquidGroundVictoryDuosCup_.desc: It's time to duo up and compete for the opportunity to win a cash prize! Reach Round 2 where every duo who earns a Victory Royale in Round 2 will earn $200 USD - good luck and have fun!

epicgames_S36_FNCSMajor3_LastChanceQuali.title: FNCS Major 3 Last Chance Qualifier
epicgames_S36_FNCSMajor3_LastChanceQuali.desc: The Last Chance Qualifier is open to all players in Divisions 1, 2 and 3 (Note: players must participate in a FNCS Division 3 Cup or higher this season or in Chapter 6 Season 2 to rank in their respective Division). The top 33 teams in each region will advance to the Last Chance Lobby, where the Victory Royale winners of each match will earn their ticket to the Major Finals!

epicgames_S36_FNCSMajor3_GroupStage_EU.title: FNCS Major 3 Group Stage
epicgames_S36_FNCSMajor3_GroupStage_EU.desc: Advance to the Group Stage by qualifying through the Play-In! The Group Stage will consist of three groups in EU and NAC, and two groups in all other regions. Every Victory Royale in the Group Stage is an instant qualification to the Major Finals! The most consistent trios in each group (top five in EU and NAC, top 10 in all other regions) will also advance to the Major Finals.

epicgames_S36_PlayStationCup_EU.title: PlayStation Cup
epicgames_S36_PlayStationCup_EU.desc: Compete against other PlayStation players in Battle Royale for an opportunity to earn a cash prize! This event occurs across multiple stages. There will be a single qualifier session, with the top 100 players advancing to the Finals. Players who earn 8 points or more in the qualifier session will earn an in-game spray!

epicgames_S36_FantasticFourCups_EU.title: Fantastic Four Cup
epicgames_S36_FantasticFourCups_EU.desc: Be Fantastic in the Fantastic Four Cup! Top performers will win the Fantastic Four Bundle before it hits the shop! Survive for 120 minutes to win the "Flame On!" Emoticon, and 60 minutes to win the "It's Clobberin' Time" Spray!

epicgames_S36_FNCSCommunityCup_EU.title: Champion Crystal FNCS Cup
epicgames_S36_FNCSCommunityCup_EU.desc: Jump in for the opportunity to earn the "Champion Crystal" outfit before it hits the shop! Players who earn 8 points will win the "Crystal's Run" Spray!

epicgames_S36_FNCSMajor3_PlayInStage_EU.title: FNCS Major 3 Play-In
epicgames_S36_FNCSMajor3_PlayInStage_EU.desc: Reach FNCS Division 1 to unlock this event. The Play-In Stage will consist of two days of competition with a cumulative leaderboard. The top trios on the leaderboard (top 99 in EU and NAC, top 66 in all other regions) will then be seeded into the Group Stage.

Players must be at least 13 years old (or such other age, if greater, as may be required in their country of residence), have MFA enabled and an account level of 50 or greater. This event is testing our tournament system and game performance at the highest level of competition for the latest update. As we're gathering performance data actively during this event, you may experience moments of low performance. This event will occur over two rounds, with the top 33 teams advancing to Round 2. Cash prizes will be awarded to top players at the conclusion of Round 2's test event. Players must be at least 13 years old

epicgames_S36_FNCSDivisionalCup_Division.title: FNCS Division 1
epicgames_S36_FNCSDivisionalCup_Division.desc: Unlock this divisional cup by qualifying from the previous season, or by advancing through FNCS Division 2. Qualification to the Division 1 Weekly Final is based on your performance across both Division 1 sessions each week, with the top 33 teams in each region qualifying to the Weekly Final.

epicgames_S36_FNCSDivisionalCup_Division.title: FNCS Division 3
epicgames_S36_FNCSDivisionalCup_Division.desc: Unlock this divisional cup by reaching Gold or higher in Battle Royale, Zero Build, or Reload Ranked. Qualification to Division 2 is based on your performance across both Division 3 sessions each week. EU: top 300 will advance to Division 2; NAC: top 200 will advance to Division 2; NAW, BR, ASIA, OCE: top 100 will advance to Division 2.

epicgames_S36_FNCSDivisionalCup_Division.title: FNCS Division 2
epicgames_S36_FNCSDivisionalCup_Division.desc: Unlock this divisional cup by qualifying from the previous season or by advancing through FNCS Division 3. Qualification to Division 1 is based on your performance across both Division 2 sessions each week. EU & NAC: top 40 will advance to Division 1; NAW, BR, ASIA, OCE, ME: top 20 will advance to Division 1.
